decision: Rejected for production; retain existing profile-wide invalidation. Tools-only dependency proof remains available in flow_routing_compare.
reason: Exact bounded seed proofs reduced synthetic rebuilding, but actual World results were mixed: Cooperative dynamic-obstacle arrivals fell 139 to 138 and exploration midpoint crossings fell 11 to 5. Exploration field work increased in both modes. Benefits do not justify extra cache/proof scheduling complexity.
scope: 200 units, 6000 ticks, identical scenario command lines and deterministic initial setup for each toggle pair. These are exploratory adoption screens, not a repeated timing benchmark or the final integrated four-mode comparison.
method: Cache an exact 256-bit allowed border-exit mask while building each field. On topology publication, discard changed source tiles and all active builders; replace destination graphs under normal destination quotas. Preserve fields only when the immutable source tile identity is unchanged, then verify each new exit bit under the existing field-work quota before exposing any sample. Changed exit masks rebuild normally. Final variant defers idle destination work until bind and retires groups with no surviving field candidates through legacy invalidation semantics. No old topology or source tile references remain.

coverage: Every passable canonical and Cooperative sample compared to full fresh field rebuild
Circle, rectangle and ring goal identities
Disconnected routes, newly opened shortcuts and recovery
Repeated topology publication while a proof is incomplete
Cancelled orders, sole-subscriber replacement and capacity limits
Idle graphs consume no work before demand; empty groups retire
Selected proof evicted by earlier builder publication; queued unselected proof evicted
Serial and parallel publication checksums at every test tick
Obsolete topology weak_ptr expires after replacement
